claim: Existence of quantum Yang-Mills theory, including coupling to fermions (committee statement, October 2026). The statement does not name the dimension or the gauge groups covered; it names SU(3) with quarks (QCD) as context and says the mass gap and confinement remain open.
scope_note: Formal statement fidelity only; not credit, news or correctness of the proof.

mandatory_relays.message: A Lean 4 theorem was stated but no Lean kernel checked it here. Treat it as a claim, not a proof.

history.reason: Statement not public: neither the 1147-page manuscript nor the Lean formalization has been released. The committee will release the Lean proof after checking that the definitions and problem statement match the standard ones.
